'''TJ Olsen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Minneapolis Grand Slam]] on 21 October 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Ops (Storm Troops and TIEs)]], according to Josh Kohman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1383">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-minneapolis-minnesota-gs-by-kohmand1383/ minneapolis-minnesota-gs-by-kohman], DeckTech (Josh "posh_josh" Kohman, 25 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-minneapolis-minnesota-gs-by-kohmand1383/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
